title: workflow_config.json
description: Project-specific configuration for the Adaptive Self-Correcting Workflow. Maps generic workflow concepts onto concrete project paths and toggles features. Consumed by hooks/workflow_hook.py.

project_root.description: Project root relative to this config file (usually ".").

roadmap_file.description: Path (relative to project_root) to the roadmap file. The SessionStart hook parses the first '**Next action:**' line from it.

retrospective_file.description: Path to the retrospective document, if used.

source_directories.description: Directories whose edits mark the session as source-changed (drives the Stop ledger reminder).

documentation_directories.description: Directories treated as documentation; touching one suppresses the doc nudge.

tool_paths.description: Map of tool name -> { path, version_flag }.

path.description: Path to the executable (absolute, or relative to project_root).

version_flag.description: Flag to query the version (e.g. '--version'). If null or empty, the hook only verifies the path exists. If omitted, '--version' is assumed.

max_blocks.description: Maximum times the Stop hook may block per session before it gives up.

main_branch.description: Name of the main/protected branch. The dirty-tree commit reminder is suppressed when on this branch. An explicit non-empty value always wins over auto-detection; omit it (or set null/"") to let main_branch_autodetect resolve it.

main_branch_autodetect.description: When main_branch is unset, detect the default branch from the repo instead of assuming 'main'. Reads the local ref refs/remotes/<main_branch_remote>/HEAD (no network); falls back to DEFAULT 'main' if that ref is absent.

main_branch_remote.description: Remote whose HEAD is consulted by main_branch_autodetect.

main_branch_probe_remote.description: Allow auto-detection to fall back to `git remote show <main_branch_remote>`, which CONTACTS THE REMOTE. Off by default so the Stop hook never makes a network call.

loop_detection.description: Agent loop detection (imported framework section 15.4). PostToolUse tracks a signature of (tool_name, tool_input); when the same call repeats consecutively at the threshold, the hook emits an advisory and appends a line to log_path. Advisory only -- it never blocks.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false, no signatures are tracked and nothing is logged.

repeat_threshold.description: Consecutive identical tool calls required before the advisory fires. Values below 2 are clamped to 2.

log_path.description: Path (relative to project_root unless absolute) of the JSONL loop log. Parent directories are created on first write.

tier0_guard.description: PreToolUse guard behind the Tier-0 prohibitions. Inspects Bash and PowerShell commands and emits permissionDecision 'deny' (force-push to a protected branch, deleting the audit trail) or 'ask' (history rewrite, heredoc stdin). Fail-open: an exception in the handler allows the call. In dontAsk mode an 'ask' becomes a silent block.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false the guard evaluates nothing and never emits a decision.

protected_branches.description: Extra branches treated as shared, in addition to the branch resolved by stop_hook.main_branch / main_branch_autodetect. A force-push whose target resolves to one of these is denied.

protected_paths.description: Paths no command may delete. Defaults to the configured ledger directory plus 'plans/archive' -- exactly what the delete-ledger prohibition names. Widen it deliberately; a Tier-0 prohibition should not grow by implication.

escalate_history_rewrite.description: Ask before `git commit --amend`, `git rebase`, `git reset --hard` and `git filter-branch`. Whether the commits are published is not visible from the command, so the guard escalates rather than guessing.

escalate_heredoc.description: Ask before heredoc stdin, `-F -` / `--file=-` / `-F /dev/stdin`, and a bare `git commit`.

governance.description: Governance library locations, consumed by `--self-test`. See docs/governance-integration-decision.md for which controls are enforced versus merely recorded.

library_root.description: Root of the chunked governance library.

maturity_tracker.description: Path that `--self-test` rewrites with the derived maturity level. Generated file -- do not hand-edit.

workflow_update_check.description: F5 daily update check for the vendored workflow-core submodule. Opt-in and notification-only: when enabled, SessionStart fetches the submodule at most once per day and reports if it is behind upstream. Never auto-applies the update.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false (default) the check is skipped entirely and no git fetch runs.

submodule_path.description: Path (relative to project_root) to the vendored workflow-core git submodule.

remote.description: Git remote of the submodule to fetch and compare against.

branch.description: Upstream branch to compare the submodule HEAD against.
